 JJ Redick calls out Raptors after Lakers victory 
 2026-11-02 05:35 
 Lakers coach JJ Redick is not happy about the lack of foul calls against the physicality imposed by the Raptors.
 Credit: AP - Scanpix 
 Credit AP - Scanpix 
 Credit AP - Scanpix 
 Add us on 
 Add us on 
 JJ Redick believes the Lakers didn't receive proper treatment from the officials given the physicality that the Toronto Raptors have shown.

 Following their 131-125 win on Sunday, the Lakers head coach voiced his frustration over the Raptors' physical play and what he felt was a lack of foul calls.
 "We scored 131 with 24 turnovers. I mean, you guys can see it. Some of those turnovers are because we're like legitimately getting fouled," Redick told reporters. "Like, it's not like, was that a foul? Was that not a foul? I told one of the referees this because all these guys do it, all the on ball defenders now. What they do is they pick you up, and then they grab the arm you're not dribbling with and then they try to steal the ball from you.
 "Famously, Cason Wallace did it with TJ McConnell. That's just the NBA right now. It's really hard when you play teams like this that are just fouling every possession. I thought we did enough to play through it, but a lot of those turnovers are just that, then you can point to some decision-making, some passes, all that stuff. Those naturally happen within the flow of the game"
 Raptors, Lakers collided in physical Sunday match
 After leading by as many as 26 points, the Los Angeles Lakers survived the Toronto Raptors' furious late-game rally, securing the key weekend home victory at Crypto.com Arena.
 The Raptors were called for 26 personal fouls throughout the evening, with the Lakers going 27-of-32 from the free-throw line as a group.
 As such, Toronto forced LA to commit 22 turnovers. The Raptors further shot 18-of-25 from the stripe.
 In the end, behind Luka Doncic's historic 45-point performance , the Lakers gained the dub over the Raptors for their fifth win of the season. Doncic went 13-for-13 from the line alone.
 Both teams are scheduled to meet again in January. 3 in Toronto.
